plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 有符号因子与移位窗 · FW-9001 · 把截断因子线的实际权送到精确的整数区间
plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-9001 · Transport a weighted factor box to its exact Bézout interval

brief.zh: 对 gcd 整除的纤维用 Bézout 解定位原点，把两个闭区间分别取整并求交。权可取截断 Möbius 除数和与两份 Mangoldt 权的乘积，取常数 1 得到实际纤维数。FW-9002 使用同一组端点。
brief.en: Use a Bézout solution on each compatible fiber. Intersect both integer ranges using floor division. Weight one gives the actual multiplicity. The same interval transports truncated Möbius and Mangoldt weights into FW-9002.
